name: Atezolizumab + Bevacizumab (IMbrave150)

biomarkers.note: No predictive biomarker gates the atezolizumab plus bevacizumab combination in HCC. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hepatocellular Carcinoma v2.2026, Principles of Biomarker Testing (HCC-J), molecular testing (MSI/dMMR, RET fusion, NTRK fusion) identifies subsequent-line targeted or immunotherapy options and does not select this first-line regimen.

lineOfTherapy: first-line systemic therapy for advanced or unresectable HCC (category 1, Preferred); also an option in subsequent-line if not previously used

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: preserved liver function (Child-Pugh A). The pivotal HCC systemic-therapy trials were limited to patients with preserved liver function; therapies may have limited safety data for Child-Pugh class B or C.
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Ch. 36; Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hepatocellular Carcinoma
eligibilityCriteria.locator: DeVita lines 111720 to 111721 (preserved liver function); NCCN v2.2026 Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2) footnotes c and d; Principles of Liver Functional Assessment (HCC-E)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: adequate endoscopic evaluation and management for esophageal varices within approximately 6 months prior to treatment (or per institutional practice), based on assessment of bleeding risk (bevacizumab bleeding risk).
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2), footnote g; Discussion (hcc.txt lines 1290, 3093 to 3095)

drugs.name: Atezolizumab

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2): Atezolizumab + Bevacizumab category 1 Preferred; reference 1 (Cheng, IMbrave150). Per-mg dose not printed.

drugs.notes: VERIFY: DeVita (Ch. 36, lines 111657 to 111667, IMbrave150 efficacy) and Standard Guidelines (NCCN) HCC v2.2026 (HCC-I 1 of 2) establish atezolizumab plus bevacizumab as the category 1 preferred first-line regimen but do NOT print the atezolizumab per-mg dose, unit, basis, or interval (IMbrave150 flat IV dosing). The published dose and schedule must be VERIFY-ed against a cited source; not inferred here. Note (HCC-I footnote e): atezolizumab and hyaluronidase-tqjs subcutaneous injection may be substituted for IV atezolizumab and has different dosing and administration.

drugs.name: Bevacizumab

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2): Atezolizumab + Bevacizumab category 1 Preferred; reference 1 (Cheng, IMbrave150). Per-kg dose not printed.

drugs.notes: VERIFY: bevacizumab is a VEGF inhibitor dosed on a mg/kg basis in IMbrave150, but the per-kg dose, unit, basis, and interval are NOT printed in the provided sources (DeVita Ch. 36 lines 111389 to 111416 and 111657 to 111667 give narrative/efficacy only). The published dose and schedule must be VERIFY-ed against a cited source; not inferred here. If populated on a mg/kg basis, use basis mgkg per the platform convention.

supportiveCare: Esophageal-varices screen: adequate endoscopic evaluation and management within approximately 6 months before starting bevacizumab (HCC-I footnote g).
Blood pressure and urine protein (proteinuria) monitoring; bleeding-risk assessment (bevacizumab).
Immune-related adverse event monitoring for atezolizumab (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary, colitis, endocrinopathies).

monitoring: Blood pressure and urine protein/proteinuria during bevacizumab
Immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) during atezolizumab

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold atezolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

doseModificationRules.condition: uncontrolled hypertension, significant proteinuria, or bleeding
doseModificationRules.text: Hold bevacizumab for uncontrolled hypertension, nephrotic-range proteinuria, or clinically significant bleeding; obtain clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Ch. 36 Cancer of the Liver, lines 111657 to 111667 (IMbrave150: atezolizumab plus bevacizumab vs sorafenib, OS/PFS benefit, new first-line SOC); bevacizumab narrative lines 111389 to 111416. No per-mg dose printed.

guideline.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2): Atezolizumab + Bevacizumab (category 1) first-line Preferred (footnotes e, f, g, h; references 1, 2 Cheng/D'Alessio, IMbrave150). Varices screen footnote g. The guideline lists the regimen by name and prints no per-mg dose.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for atezolizumab plus bevacizumab (IMbrave150) as first-line systemic therapy for advanced or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (#22). The Standard Guidelines (NCCN) HCC v2.2026 Principles of Systemic Therapy (HCC-I 1 of 2) and DeVita 12th ed. Ch. 36 (lines 111657 to 111667) establish this as the category 1 preferred first-line regimen but print NO per-mg or per-kg doses. Accordingly the atezolizumab dose/unit/basis/days and bevacizumab dose/unit/basis/days, and the regimen cycleLengthDays and cycles, are all set to VERIFY and must be VERIFY-ed against a cited source; none were inferred. Safety-critical eligibility is grounded: preserved liver function (Child-Pugh A) per DeVita lines 111720 to 111721 and HCC-I caution footnotes c and d, and the mandatory esophageal-varices endoscopic evaluation within approximately 6 months before bevacizumab per HCC-I footnote g (Discussion hcc.txt lines 1290, 3093 to 3095). Bevacizumab hypertension/proteinuria/bleeding monitoring and atezolizumab immune-related adverse event monitoring are carried in monitoring and doseModificationRules. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
